## 1. Abstract & Formal Statement

The deltoid-cover candidate box requires |U_00|^2 >= 81/100, giving margin (81/100 - 1/6)^2 = 37249/90000, while every basis unbiased to the standard basis has |U_00|^2 = 1/6; so the box contains no admissible candidate and its exclusion covers none.

### Governing Obligation
Subdividing the family parameter domain does not enlarge this candidate domain; a valid cover must range over candidates with all squared entry moduli 1/6.

### Witness Audit
Arithmetic from the stated box bound; the Rust box is external.
